rv.q: This show is perfect for those who enjoy musical comedies full of spectacle.
THE PRODUCERS is a whole lot of fun…especially Act 2!
In spite of some occasional shortcomings, there's still a lot to recommend in Music Theater Works latest production, their 150th.

Mel Brooks is one of the great geniuses of comedy hands down and The Producers is one of his many masterpieces. Music Theater Works celebrates its 150th show under the direction of L. Walter Stearns. A stellar cast gives fine performances showing the underbelly of show business while spoofing the Third Reich and its leader as preening closet cases.
Their 150th production is Mel Brooks zany comedy, 'The Producers' and what a wonderful evening of theater it is!
The Producers is a fun break in the theater season.

cn.t: Critics praise this "absurdly fun" production of Mel Brooks' zany musical, with strong direction and choreography that makes excellent use of the larger theater space. The show's trademark offensive humor continues to entertain while shocking audiences.
